final: WITH member_attendance AS (SELECT a.link_to_member as member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) as attendance_count FROM attendance a INNER JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, ROUND(CAST(attendance_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(attendance_count) FROM member_attendance), 6) as share FROM member_attendance ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
